questions.stem: Find the ODD one out: Carpenter, Blacksmith, Weaver, Tailor, Mechanic

options.option_text: Mechanic (correct: carpenter, blacksmith, weaver, tailor = traditional craft workers making physical items by hand; mechanic = repairs machines — different category ✓)

questions.explanation: B is correct. Carpenter (wood), Blacksmith (metal), Weaver (cloth), Tailor (clothes) = all traditional craftspeople who CREATE items. A Mechanic REPAIRS machines — a different type of skilled worker. The odd one out is Mechanic.

questions.stem: Find the ODD one out: Python, Java, Cobra, C++, JavaScript

options.option_text: Cobra (correct: Python, Java, C++, JavaScript = programming languages; Cobra = a snake ✓)

questions.explanation: C is correct. Python, Java, C++, JavaScript = all programming languages. COBRA = a type of venomous snake. The odd one out is Cobra. Note: Python is also a snake, which makes this a tricky question — but Cobra is NOT a programming language, while Python IS.

questions.stem: Find the ODD one out: Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Moon, Saturn

options.option_text: Moon (correct: Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn = planets of our solar system; Moon = Earth's natural satellite, not a planet ✓)

questions.explanation: C is correct. Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn = PLANETS of the solar system. Moon = Earth's natural SATELLITE (not a planet). The classification difference: all others are planets; Moon is a satellite.

questions.stem: Find the ODD one out: Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass, Orchestra

options.option_text: Orchestra (correct: Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass = vocal range types (singing voices); Orchestra = a large group of musicians playing instruments, not a singing voice ✓)

questions.explanation: D is correct. Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass = VOCAL RANGES (types of singing voices in classical music). Orchestra = an ensemble of musicians playing instruments — completely different category. The odd one out is Orchestra.

questions.stem: Find the ODD one out: Triangle, Pentagon, Hexagon, Cube, Octagon

options.option_text: Cube (correct: Triangle, Pentagon, Hexagon, Octagon = 2D flat shapes (polygons); Cube = 3D solid shape ✓)

questions.explanation: C is correct. Triangle, Pentagon, Hexagon, Octagon = 2D POLYGONS (flat shapes with straight sides). Cube = 3D SOLID shape (6 square faces). The Cube is the odd one out as it belongs to a different dimension category.

questions.stem: Find the ODD one out: Cricket, Hockey, Polo, Tennis, Baseball

options.option_text: Polo (correct: Cricket, Hockey, Tennis, Baseball use balls; all are ground-based sports; Polo is also ground-based... actually: Cricket, Hockey, Tennis, Baseball = team/individual sports NOT requiring horses; Polo = equestrian team sport requiring horses ✓)

questions.explanation: C is correct. Cricket, Hockey, Tennis, Baseball = played on foot without horses. POLO = played on horseback; it's an equestrian sport. The odd one out is Polo as it requires horses while all others are non-equestrian.

questions.stem: Find the ODD one out: Malaria, Dengue, Typhoid, Cholera, Influenza

options.option_text: Typhoid (wrong: typhoid is bacterial — let's check more carefully)
Cholera (wrong: cholera is bacterial; let's check if influenza is the odd one here)

Influenza (correct: Malaria and Dengue = mosquito-borne; Typhoid and Cholera = water/food-borne; Influenza = air-borne respiratory disease — all the others are tropical/vector diseases, while influenza is respiratory ✓)

questions.explanation: C is correct. Malaria and Dengue = mosquito-borne. Typhoid and Cholera = waterborne/foodborne. Influenza = airborne respiratory virus. All the others are tropical diseases spread through vectors or contaminated water/food. Influenza is the odd one out as a respiratory infection common in temperate climates.

questions.stem: Find the ODD one out: Rupee, Dollar, Euro, Pound, Bitcoin

options.option_text: Bitcoin (correct: Rupee, Dollar, Euro, Pound = fiat currencies issued by governments; Bitcoin = decentralised cryptocurrency, not issued by any government ✓)

questions.explanation: C is correct. Rupee, Dollar, Euro, Pound = FIAT CURRENCIES (government-issued, legal tender in their respective countries). Bitcoin = CRYPTOCURRENCY (decentralised digital currency not issued by any government). The odd one out is Bitcoin.

questions.stem: Find the ODD one out: Novel, Biography, Autobiography, Diary, Thermometer

options.option_text: Thermometer (correct: Novel, Biography, Autobiography, Diary = types of written/literary works; Thermometer = a scientific measuring instrument ✓)

questions.explanation: D is correct. Novel, Biography, Autobiography, Diary = all literary/written forms. Thermometer = a scientific instrument for measuring temperature — completely unrelated to literature. The odd one out is Thermometer.

questions.stem: Find the ODD one out: Sitar, Violin, Flute, Tabla, Guitar

options.option_text: Flute (correct: Sitar, Violin, Tabla, Guitar — Sitar/Violin/Guitar are string instruments; Tabla is a percussion instrument; Flute is a wind instrument. However: Tabla (percussion) vs all others are melodic; OR Flute (wind) vs others. The strongest 'odd one out' grouping: Sitar, Violin, Guitar = string (chordophone); Tabla = drum (percussion); Flute = wind ✓)
Tabla (percussion instrument — the only non-string/wind here)

questions.explanation: B is correct if the group = Sitar + Violin + Guitar (strings) + Tabla (drum) — Flute (wind) is different. However if the group = all melodic instruments vs Tabla (only rhythm instrument), Tabla could be odd. Most standard reasoning tests would pick FLUTE (wind/aerophone) as the odd one when the others include strings and Tabla, making Flute the only wind instrument.
